verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published TFLOPS or TOPS figure for the RTX 5090 at any stated precision or sparsity. The Tensor Core claim lists supported precisions (FP4, FP6, FP8, FP16, BF16, TF32) but gives only a relative "up to 3x higher throughput" figure. Other material is marketing ("unprecedented AI horsepower") or relative community benchmarks (1.42x vs 4090), none of which lets an engineer size training or inference from stated tensor throughput.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can size training and inference from published tensor throughput — TFLOPS or TOPS with precision and sparsity stated, not a bare marketing number
